story: Mahishasura, who could switch between buffalo and human form, won a boon that no man or god could kill him. He conquered heaven and drove out the gods, until Durga, created from all their powers, fought him and killed him.
belief: He is the demon of Durga Puja, shown dying beneath Durga and her lion. Some communities, including the Asur tribe, honour him as a just ancestral king, and Mysuru is popularly said to take its name from him.
turns: He was sure no woman could ever defeat him and ignored the danger. His desire to possess Durga drew him into the battle that ended him.
facts: Durga is called Mahishasuramardini, 'slayer of Mahishasura'.
Mysuru's Chamundi Hills are linked to his defeat.
His boon protected him from men and gods, but not from a goddess.
